finalText:
Build is clean now — exit 0, 0 errors. What was going on:

- The bulk of the "screen full of warnings" is just harmless Node deprecation noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) plus a couple of real-but-minor lint-style warnings (unused export, circular import) — those are still there (8 warnings total) but don't fail the build.
- The actual build failure was two bugs the dependency bump introduced at the link stage:
  - `src/core/options.js:7` — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but the code still read `options.retries`, so it threw on `undefined.toFixed`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
  - `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — the new config loader leaves an unset flag as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict check only handled `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

Both are one-line fixes; build now completes and emits `dist/bundle.js`.
